lines.text: The LORD will have compassion on Jacob and settle Israel in their own land, and the nations will escort them home.
Israel will sing a song of contempt against the king of Babylon, because the LORD has broken the staff of the wicked.
The cypresses and cedars of Sinai exult because no woodcutter comes against them since the king was laid low.
The day star said he would raise his throne above the stars of God, but he will be brought down to the Pit.
The LORD of Hosts says He will cut off Babylon's name and sweep her away with the sword of destruction.
